about_the_game:
Developed by BattleCry Studio, Cthulhu Detective is a classic detective game infused with the essence of the Shin Honkaku (New Orthodox) mystery genre. Set in a world where humans and gods coexist, the game blends rational deduction with the supernatural to create a uniquely immersive atmosphere. Beyond the traditional approach of presenting evidence and spotting contradictions, players can pursue multiple paths to apprehend the culprit, offering a greater degree of freedom in deduction. Along the way, you will discover many hidden Easter eggs and many unexpected events.

Step into Cthulhu Detective, solve intricate cases, capture the true culprits, and uncover the conspiracies lurking behind them all.

Gameplay and Features：

Shin Honkaku Mystery

Cthulhu Detective expands the possibilities of deduction games by integrating supernatural fantasy elements with authentic cases, pushing the joy of solving mysteries to the NEXT LEVEL.

Even Crimes Committed by Gods Leave Traces

The game takes place in a fictional near-modern world infused with “light Cthulhu” elements—a mysterious world where humans and gods coexist. The secretive organization AIB (Agency of Investigating the Bizarre) operates in the shadows, containing and safeguarding unknown artifacts—lost relics of gods and forbidden powers. Meanwhile, whispers of acquiring supernatural abilities can be heard in the hidden corners of the city.

And you, a rookie cop, must navigate this tangled web of mysteries. Can you solve one case after another, uncover the truth hidden beneath the ordinary facade, and realize—humanity has never been the sole master of this world?

300,000 Words of Narrative Depth

Immerse yourself in a narrative of over 300,000 words, where complex case logic intertwines with a diverse cast of characters.

Multiple Paths to Catch the Killer

Rigid structures of “evidence collection + deduction phase” can sometimes be frustrating, especially when you're stuck wondering “Where’s the last missing piece of evidence?”
Cthulhu Detective offers a more flexible system that combines evidence collection and deduction seamlessly. Investigate the scene, connect the clues, and deduce at your own pace. Each case offers multiple solutions, allowing you to unravel the truth through different reasoning routes.

Easter Eggs and Unpredictable Events

Every choice you make can trigger a butterfly effect! With a highly dynamic interaction system, your every move is woven into the narrative, creating a realistic and immersive experience filled with dark humor.

Perhaps it’s the consequence of “excessive force”—rough treatment of a suspect might lead to a complaint, damaging the team's reputation and prompting an angry call from your boss.

Or maybe it’s a “slip of the tongue”—complain about a “godforsaken place,” and you might step on animal poo the very next second.

Sometimes, NPC-driven uncontrollable events can occur—if you push a depressed suspect too hard, they may shut down completely, requiring you to rebuild trust before proceeding.

Every choice, every talk—leads to unexpected outcomes, making for an endlessly entertaining journey!

The Key to Fast Progress? “Role-Playing”!

Yes, role-playing is the secret. While your official job is “detective,” sometimes seeking the truth requires stepping into different roles.
To enhance the authenticity (not just for NPCs), we’ve even brought in DeepSeek and Tongyi Qianwen to assist. How does the “role-playing method” work? A tiny spoiler:

🤓🤡, 🤐🤔🥴😃🤫🧐

Character Introduction

  • Name: Tifa

  • Age: ??? (Don’t ask, no living soul knows.)

  • Race: ???

  • Occupation: Director of Operations, AIB

  • Evaluates events from a “global perspective”, specializing in establishing macro-level order. Enforces the will of the Seven Gods by eliminating those who seek to attain supernatural powers without permission.

  • Name: Qin Ming

  • Age: 24

  • Occupation: Forensic Specialist

  • A beautiful and determined young woman whose ultimate goal is to speak for the dead. Though she joined the police force full of enthusiasm, she was relegated to menial tasks. When assigned to assist Mo Yu in investigating the Bruce Mansion case, she was unexpectedly drawn into a supernatural event. Unlike others, Qin Ming was thrilled by the danger, seeing it as a chance to bring her forensic expertise to the next level.

  • Name: Mo Yu

  • Age: 25

  • Occupation: Rookie Cop

  • Graduated without distinction from the police academy and was randomly assigned to the peaceful Pureplain City Police Department. While investigating the Bruce Mansion case, he was unexpectedly entangled in supernatural events. However, Mo Yu secretly yearns to return to the ordinary life he once had.

Are You Ready to Embrace the Unknown?

 Cthulhu Detective will drag you into an unpredictable psychological labyrinth, challenging the limits of your reasoning. Will you uncover the truth in this chaotic world, or will you slowly descend into madness...?

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: violence, blood & gore, partial nudity, and suggestive themes.
